tools.name: search_bundles
tools.description: Search the index of OKF bundles: free text over name, tagline, description and origin; filter by provenance (github|domain), repository, version, language, license, root type or concept count; search root concept text. Paginate with limit/offset.

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: One bundle's card: root index.md URL, version, concept count, provenance and repository signal.

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: Size of the index by provenance and when it last changed.

tools.name: feed_find
tools.description: Does this site publish a feed? Answers with every feed known for a domain — the question a reader or an agent actually asks.

tools.name: feed_posts
tools.description: What has this feed published? The posts of one feed as our queue read them — title, date, author, summary, categories and enclosure, without the body. Find the feed first (feed_find or feed_search); this takes an id from this index, never a URL.

tools.name: feed_post
tools.description: Read one post whole: the body in Markdown (`conteudo`) and the author's formatting as safe HTML (`conteudo_html`), plus the link to the original. `ord` comes from feed_posts; 0 is the newest.

tools.name: feed_search
tools.description: Search the feed index by text and filters: format, audio/video, community, namespace and year of the newest item.

tools.name: mcp_index_signals
tools.description: Does this MCP server still answer, with which access, and is its repository alive? What independent MCP indexes measured about one listing of this catalog, each credited with its license. Take the id from list_listings.

tools.name: mcp_index_search
tools.description: Browse what independent MCP indexes measured, including servers this catalog does not list yet (casou=0).

tools.name: api_index
tools.description: Index of the Mural API.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Liveness.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.description: Creates a guest mr_…

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Public mosaic of live MCP servers, skills, plugins and OKF knowledge bundles.

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: MCP subregistry (GET /v0.1/servers). Only live kind=mcp.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing's page.

tools.name: get_listing_readme
tools.description: README collected for a listing (R2). Only when get_listing carries readme_api; 404 when none was stored.

tools.name: listing_history
tools.description: Timeline of the listing's repository: last events (abandono = no push for 12 months, sumiu, renomeado, readme_mudou, manifesto_mudou), newest first; empty when nothing changed since the series began.

tools.name: go_listing
tools.description: 302 hop to the listing's origin (counts a visit).

tools.name: like_listing
tools.description: Reversible like.

tools.name: list_comments

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Registers an MCP server, skill or plugin (human session free; agent without session = 402 $0.10).

tools.name: listing_status
tools.description: Moderation state of a listing (pending / live / low / hidden / blocked) — poll it after create_listing. No credential; only the decision comes back.

tools.name: submit_okf

tools.name: api_access_buy
tools.description: Buy 1,000 basic data reads for US$1, valid for 30 days. Requires explicit payment. MAT-only balance; pass prefix mat_.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bundle, feed_posts, feed_post, feed_search, list_comments · Private data: listing_status, submit_okf, contact, api_access · Public sink: feed_find, feed_post, submit_okf · Destructive: feed_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bundle, feed_posts, feed_post, feed_search, list_comments · Private data: listing_status, submit_okf, contact, api_access · Public sink: feed_find, feed_post, submit_okf · Destructive: feed_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
